title: Caught in the Net
author: Emile Gaboriau
description: "Caught in the Net" by Emile Gaboriau is a novel likely written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: This work explores the lives of marginalized individuals living in Paris, focusing on themes of love, poverty, and the social struggles of the time.

authorInfo.bio: Étienne Émile Gaboriau was a French writer, novelist, journalist, and a pioneer of detective fiction.
